headlines.title: א-שרע בניו יורק: מבין את מה שקרה ב-7.10, לא הגיוני שזה יכתיב את המדיניות כלפי סוריה
headlines.snippet: Syrian President al-Sharaa, speaking in New York, expressed understanding for the events of October 7th but argued they should not dictate policy toward Syria. He lamented that Israel seeks security by creating surrounding problems, which he stated is ineffective and requires a policy change. Al-Sharaa also revealed past close calls for a political settlement between the two nations, which Israel ultimately abandoned.

Netanyahu responded by calling Macron's statement absurd, highlighting that a French citizen was recently killed by a Hamas member in the West Bank.

headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Katz warned Hamas that if a single Israeli soldier or citizen is abducted, the entire city of Gaza will be evacuated. Speaking at a memorial ceremony, Katz asserted that they would not retreat from their current stance in Gaza until Hamas is removed and the area is demilitarized. He also addressed the campaign against Iran, claiming the elimination of Khamenei prevented a nuclear threat, and emphasized that the work is not finished.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ מזהיר את חמאס: "אם ייחטף חייל או אזרח ישראלי - העיר עזה כולה תפונה"

headlines.title: נשיא סוריה לברק רביד: "מבין את מה שקרה ב-7 באוקטובר לחפים מפשע, אך לא ייתכן שזה יקבע את המדיניות כלפינו"
headlines.snippet: Syrian President al-Sharaa told Barak Ravid that he understands the events of October 7th and the impact on innocent people, but stated this should not determine policy towards Syria. Al-Sharaa recalled near-concluding a settlement with Israel, but noted Israel withdrew at the last moment. Regarding the Golan Heights, he affirmed it is Syrian territory recognized by the UN, with no discussion on its ownership.

headlines.title: מקרון באמירה מקוממת: "חמאס מעולם לא פעל בגדה המערבית"

He stated the need to respect the Palestinian people's right to exist. Netanyahu reacted strongly, calling the statement "unthinkable absurdity" and pointing out a recent French citizen's death by a Hamas operative in the West Bank. Izankov also commented, calling the statement "extremely disconnected from reality."

His 16-year-old son, Yoav, who was with him during the attack, said goodbye, and his wife Merav described him as an involved father. His sister Ruti remembered him as a pleasant, intelligent, and modest person.

headlines.snippet_he: לפי TRT World, כל חברות התעופה האיראניות צפויות להתמודד עם סגירה עולמית החל מיום רביעי.

headlines.title: President Erdogan arrives in New York ahead of 81st UN General Assembly session
headlines.snippet: President Erdogan arrived in New York ahead of the 81st UN General Assembly session. This was reported by TRT World.

headlines.title: Türkiye, seven other nations demand Israel end Gaza ceasefire violations, fulfil commitments
headlines.snippet: Türkiye and seven other nations are demanding that Israel end its Gaza ceasefire violations and fulfill its commitments. This was reported by TRT World.

headlines.title: Erdogan calls for UN Security Council reform, urges abolition of veto power
headlines.snippet: President Erdogan called for reform of the UN Security Council, advocating for the abolition of veto power. This was reported by TRT World.

headlines.title: Arab nations condemn Ben-Gvir's provocative incursion into Al-Aqsa Mosque compound
headlines.snippet: Arab nations have condemned the provocative incursion of Ben-Gvir into the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound. This was reported by TRT World.
